name: Battery
summary: An electrochemical electrical source or storage element represented in a circuit.
description: A battery representation identifies an electrochemical source or energy-storage element. The generic depiction can suggest cells or polarity, but it does not determine the number of cells, chemistry, voltage, energy capacity or protective equipment in the selected system.

A battery energy storage system adds controls, power conversion and other equipment around its storage element. System drawings should distinguish the DC battery circuit from AC conversion, switching and protection. The physical battery cabinet is a separate GA object.
readingNotes: Identify whether the drawing denotes a cell, battery bank or complete storage system.
Read DC polarity and the conversion interface from the documented arrangement.
drawingChecklist: Reference voltage and storage equipment data.
Separate DC storage and AC interfaces.
distinction: A battery is a storage element. A BESS includes additional equipment and controls; the terms do not identify identical scope.
